# Delegation brief

A practical agent skill for clarifying what a person wants before an AI agent recommends or takes action. It separates stated requirements, assumptions, missing trade-offs, and authorization.

## Try it

Copy this folder into the skills directory for your agent, following its installation instructions. In Codex, request `$delegation-brief` with a real task. For example:

> Use $delegation-brief to help me delegate choosing wireless headphones for work and travel. My budget is ₹10,000. Identify the trade-offs that matter and prepare a brief I can correct before you recommend products.

The skill is a decision aid, not an access control or proof of preference alignment. It has not yet been independently tested. See [research notes](references/evidence.md) and the [worked example](references/example.md).
